title: Checkpoint: Class-token container
prompt:
Inside Solution, implement `public static class Types` — the type-safe
heterogeneous container:
1. Private `Map<Class<?>, Object> data = new HashMap<>()`.
2. `public <T> void put(Class<T> type, T value)` — store under the token.
3. `public <T> T get(Class<T> type)` — retrieve via `type.cast(...)` so the
returned value is genuinely a T (no unchecked warnings).
4. `public <T> boolean has(Class<T> type)` — true iff a value was put for that token.
Retrieval must be exact: two different tokens hold two different values, and each
get() returns the value stored under ITS OWN token.

tests.name: two tokens, two values, exact retrieval
tests.hint: Each token retrieves exactly what it stored.

tests.name: subtype tokens are honored
